name: poopdeck-ai
description: AI-assisted suite for poopdeck.gl / SpatioTemporal Tiles. Bundles the @poopdeck.gl/mcp server (auto-registered via .mcp.json) and a set of Agent Skills covering the full toolchain: build a .stt from GeoParquet or a DB, generate the bundled reference datasets, tune/lint/export tiles for publishing, wire a deck.gl SpatioTemporalLayer, and debug blank renders.
